failure.reason: The Command Center recovery-hold configuration intentionally kept NEMOTRON_BASE_URL empty, while the activation lane expected Command Center to route through Nemotron before transactionally converging that runtime configuration.

remediation.strategy: Back up the complete Command Center env, set only the non-secret Nemotron loopback URL and reviewed model, recreate only the Command Center container to load those values, prove source=nemotron, and restore the prior env/container automatically on any later failure.
